label: lawyer or attorney for
definition: Person 1 is or was a lawyer or attorney serving principal, organization or jurisdiction 2.
scope_notes: Includes legal employment at a firm and government attorney offices for a jurisdiction. Merely working as a lawyer in a city may establish place of practice but not representation of that city; review jurisdiction ambiguity. Travel, sports and corporate nationality are competing predicates.

facts.reason: Bush returns to, meets in and speaks in Washington; these paths do not establish an attorney role.
Britain returns/transfers territory to China. This is an intergovernmental handover rather than legal representation.
Bush asks Congress in the sole path; this communication does not establish him as its lawyer.
Sanofi is described using French corporate nationality and ownership paths, with no lawyer/attorney role.
Morgenthau is explicitly attorney for/of Manhattan; these direct jurisdictional role paths establish more than merely practicing law in the city.
